MILLBROOK ORTHOPEDIC ASSOCIATES

45 Elm Street, Millbrook, NH 03055 Tel 555-0199

NEW PATIENT EVALUATION

PATIENT	DOB	MRN	DATE OF SERVICE
Priya Reyes	05/22/1990	882-1190-O	03/09/2024

HISTORY: Patient seen for persistent neck and low back pain following a rear-end motor vehicle collision on 03/01/2024. Treated at Riverbend ED same week, X-rays negative for fracture. Pain has improved only slightly with rest, ibuprofen, and cyclobenzaprine.

EXAM: Cervical range of motion reduced approximately 25% in flexion/extension, paraspinal tenderness C4-C6. Lumbar range of motion reduced approximately 20%, paraspinal tenderness L4-S1. Straight leg raise negative bilaterally. Motor and sensory exam intact.

ASSESSMENT: Post-traumatic cervical strain. Post-traumatic lumbar strain. Rule out disc pathology given persistent symptoms beyond one week.

PLAN: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to rule out disc herniation given persistent symptoms. Refer to physical therapy, twice weekly for 6 weeks. Continue current medications.

Dr. Sana Okafor, MD - Orthopedic Surgery
NPI 1740882213 - Signed 03/09/2024

MILLBROOK ORTHOPEDIC ASSOCIATES - IMAGING REPORT

EXAMINATION: MRI Lumbar Spine without contrast
DATE OF SERVICE: 03/15/2024
INTERPRETING MD: Dr. Sana Okafor, MD

FINDINGS: Vertebral body heights and alignment are normal. No disc herniation, no significant disc bulge, no spinal canal or neuroforaminal stenosis. Mild loss of normal lumbar lordosis, consistent with muscle spasm.

IMPRESSION: No acute structural abnormality. Findings consistent with soft tissue strain, no evidence of disc herniation.

Dax Reyes 882-1190-O 03/15/2024

SUMMARY: Patient completed a course of physical therapy from 03/20/2024 through 05/01/2024 (12 sessions), addressing post-traumatic cervical and lumbar strain following the 03/01/2024 motor vehicle collision.
